Block elements treated as inline

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert, ConversionOptions

def main() -> None:
    html = "<p>One</p><p>Two</p>"
    options = ConversionOptions(convert_as_inline=True)
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result)

main()
```
